* Caller must only invoke when introspection_url is present (same gate as AuthPolicy).
* Missing client credentials emit a WARNING with REPLACE_ME placeholders.
* Operator-facing WARNINGs for rate-limit semantic approximations (#8–#10).
* Empty when neither edge_limiting approximations nor plan ceilings apply.

primary.body:
## Summary
Closes remaining checklist items from #35 (PR1–PR4 policy conversion review):
- **Security:** OPA uses `input.attributes.source.address` (not XFF); apiKey/appIdKey Secrets scoped to target namespace; blank CIDRs skipped with warn
- **Bugs:** CORS Allow-Credentials indent aligned; incomplete `token_introspection` no longer emits mismatched oauth2 Secret
- **Docs:** WARNING comments for connection_limiters→rate, leaky_bucket→fixed window, plan ceiling = max across plans
- **Style:** FQN→imports; drop unused `@SuppressWarnings` on `edgeLimiterName`

Already fixed on main (no-op): #6 packageGrows assertion, #11 redundant boolean, #14 ConversionServiceTest reflection, #15 Japanese README.  
**Deferred:** #7 YAML string-concat rewrite (high blast radius).

## Linked Issue
Closes #35

## Test plan
- [x] `mvn -Dtest=ConversionServiceTest test` (80 tests)
- [ ] Full backend CI on this PR
- [ ] Spot-check generated OPA Rego / AuthPolicy Secret selectors / CORS YAML indent

## Notes for @pcastelo
- Authorino must populate `source.address` at runtime (no XFF fallback by design).
- Dropping `allNamespaces` may break demos that rely on cross-namespace Secrets.


Made with [Cursor](https://cursor.com)
